evidence.quote: The sheet was step-by-step cold-rolled along the length direction at room temperature by using a laboratory scale rolling equipment having rollers with a diameter of 16 mm, and a length of 260 mm. The surfaces of the sample and rollers were lubricated using oil in each step, and the reduction in thickness by each step was ~0.2 mm. The thickness of the sheet was reduced to 2 mm that is approximately 77.8% reduction.
